messages:
oncall-bot: PAGING: SLO breach detected for /v1/stream (p99 latency > 3s) · incident_id=INC-2026-39999 · auto-alert at 2026-03-15T02:10:00Z :rotating_light:
oncall-bot: Symptoms: streaming stalls observed, high tail latency on tokenization/preproc, increased queueing in prompt-kit workers. Alerting thresholds: p95 700ms, p99 3s — current p95 ~950ms, p99 ~5.2s (ingress metric).
elaine: I'm on it — grabbing logs and checking preproc worker metrics. anyone oncall for prompt-kit? @kevin?
kevin: here. seeing huge CPU spikes on preproc-pool-3 and many requests stuck in `parse-json-mode` path. Likely related to recent prompt-kit v2 change that added JSON mode validation.
mira: I see a surge of templates hitting the tool-schema hydrator. template_hydration_time p99 jumped from 30ms -> 1.2s for a subset of requests. That can cascade into tokenizer backlog.
jordan: customer impact? which customers are affected? any high-traffic tenants on Dedicated?
elaine: Quick customer check: two active Dedicated tenants (acme-corp, nova-scan) show elevated errors/timeouts on streaming endpoints. Postgres trace shows many preproc entries with large payloads (templates+tools schema embedded).
kevin: hypothesis: prompt-kit v2 introduced on-the-fly JSON mode parsing for tool schemas which is expensive for large payloads. Combined with cold KV cache for template expansions -> blocking preproc threads.
mira: corroborating: pod logs have repeated stack traces in prompt_builder::json_mode::parse and GC pressure. Allocations spike during template expansion step.
eng-runtime-bot: Metric snapshot: streaming_tail_latency_p99 = 5.2s, preproc_queue_length = 82 (threshold 40), preproc_worker_cpu_util = 96% on nodes n-preproc-[3..5], tokenizer_rate_limit_drops = 0.8%
elaine: Mitigation plan (immediate): 1) disable JSON mode short-circuit for streaming routes (config flag) 2) scale preproc pool by +2 pods 3) enable fallback to cached precompiled templates for the top-50 templates. Doing step 1 now.
kevin: Patch applied: `PROMPT_KIT_JSONMODE=false` for streaming tier via config rollout (canary to 10% -> 100%). Rolling out now.
mira: Scaling preproc: deployed 2 extra replicas to preproc-autoscale group. Watch CPU and queue length.
elaine: Enabling cached precompile for top templates (hotlist) on prompt-kit; flip `PRECOMPILE_HOTLIST=on`. Doing a small canary.
jordan: Noted. Notifying account execs for acme-corp and nova-scan with ETA 15m for mitigation.
eng-runtime-bot: After step 1 rollout: p95 -> 680ms, p99 -> 2.0s, preproc_queue_length -> 45. Improvement but still above SLO for p99.
kevin: JSON mode disable removed the heavy parse path; remaining tail is from template hydration and tokenizer cold starts. Next-minute action: warm up KV cache for template expansions on preproc nodes. running `curl` warmups against /internal/cache/warmup for top templates.
mira: Warmup executed. After warmup: preproc_queue_length -> 22, p95 -> 420ms, p99 -> 1.1s. Streaming stalls mostly cleared.
elaine: Customer impact update: acme-corp observed transient streaming hiccups for ~11 minutes, nova-scan for ~14 minutes. No data loss. We've offered a brief incident summary and priority support channel.
jordan: Any need to escalate to SRE or customer success?
kevin: We should create a follow-up rollback/patch: revert prompt-kit v2 JSON parsing approach and replace with incremental parser + rate-limiter on payload size. I'll open an RFC and a revert PR.
mira: Action items: - kevin: PR to revert JSON mode hot-path (owner). - elaine: post-incident customer impact note and update pages. - eng-runtime: add a conservative CPU-based autoscale trigger to preproc. - infra: investigate why KV cache cold-start is slow for the template hotlist.
elaine: tagging for postmortem: @eng-runtime, @eng-ml, @sre. Setting priority = P2 for now, but will upgrade if we see reoccurrence.
kevin: quick log snippet from preproc pod 3: ```
[2026-03-15T02:08:52Z] prompt_builder::json_mode::parse - payload_size=1.2MB duration=1240ms
[2026-03-15T02:08:52Z] preproc::worker - queue_wait=860ms
[2026-03-15T02:08:53Z] tokenizer::tokenize - tokens=3120 latency=24ms
```
mira: Note: tokenizer latency per call is fine; the blocking factor was preproc/template hydration & GC. We'll instrument memallocs on next deploy.
elaine: On-call handoff in 18 minutes to @kevin. leaving notes in rotation with mitigation steps and links to dashboards: https://redwood.infra/dashboards/streaming-tail and https://redwood.infra/logs?query=prompt_builder.json_mode
kevin: Taking handoff. I'll track the revert PR and the autoscale rule. If p99 climbs above 2.5s again, page SRE escalation.
eng-runtime-bot: Final snapshot at 02:24Z: p95=410ms p99=980ms preproc_queue=18 preproc_cpu=58% streaming_errors=0.05%
elaine: Thanks team. Filing postmortem draft and adding timeline. Will include mitigation timeline, customer impact, and follow-ups. :memo: (reaction :white_check_mark:)
kevin: I'll start the revert PR now and add a loadtest to simulate large tool-schema payloads.
mira: Will add allocation profiling to the next images.
elaine: Closing the live thread, leaving it open for updates. Postmortem owners: elaine, kevin, mira.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-39999 mitigated and moved to post-incident review.
